_about: Narration for the Spend Radar demo film (v3: the papery cartoon world, comp/comp.js). `say` is what the voice reads (spelled for pronunciation); `cap` is the on-screen caption; `big` lines are drawn as huge kinetic type. `exag` = expressiveness for that line. Every number comes from the evidence named in `src`.

lines.say: So... your competitor just doubled their em ell team.
lines.cap: So… your competitor just doubled their ML team.

lines.say: And you? You'll find out next quarter.
lines.cap: And you? You'll find out next quarter.

lines.say: Unless your agent finds out first.
lines.cap: Unless your agent finds out first.

lines.say: This is Spend Radar. It reads your books, checks the market, then tries to prove itself wrong.
lines.cap: This is Spend Radar. It reads your books, checks the market, then tries to prove itself wrong.

lines.say: Let's watch it work, on a real run.
lines.cap: Let's watch it work, on a real run.

lines.say: The model writes a plan, and the agent works through it, one tool call at a time.
lines.cap: The model writes a plan, and the agent works through it, one tool call at a time.

lines.say: It reads the budget, the invoices and the policy, then pulls real competitor headcount from Crust-data.
lines.cap: It reads the budget, the invoices and the policy, then pulls real competitor headcount from Crustdata.

lines.say: Python checks every single result. Seventy-one checks in all. And here's one that fails: a budget row that doesn't add up.
lines.cap: Python checks every single result — 71 checks in all. And here's one that fails: a budget row that doesn't add up.

lines.say: The rule says, just mark it low confidence. But the model decides to re-read that exact row instead.
lines.cap: The rule says: just mark it low confidence. But the model decides to re-read that exact row instead.

lines.say: A scanned PDF gets read another way. A corrupt one gets flagged, and the run keeps going.
lines.cap: A scanned PDF gets read another way. A corrupt one gets flagged, and the run keeps going.
lines.src: decisions t15 reparse_alt; t16/t16r reparse_alt, skip; not_analysed

lines.say: In this run, five of its ten recovery calls beat the default rule.
lines.cap: In this run, 5 of its 10 recovery calls beat the default rule.

lines.say: Now, here's our favourite part.
lines.cap: Now, here's our favourite part.

lines.say: The agent flagged a gap of up to five point two eight million dollars in Acme's em ell team.
lines.cap: The agent flagged a gap of up to $5.28M in Acme's ML team.

lines.say: Then it argued with itself, and overturned its own claim.
lines.cap: Then it argued with itself — and overturned its own claim.

lines.say: So that wrong number never reaches the report.
lines.cap: So that wrong number never reaches the report.

lines.say: Seven companies. Six it had never seen.
lines.cap: Seven companies. Six it had never seen.

lines.say: Every planted error was caught, with zero false alarms.
lines.cap: Every planted error caught — with zero false alarms.

lines.say: When it broke, neet logs found the incidents for us.
lines.cap: When it broke, neatlogs found the incidents for us.
lines.src: neatlogs Traces view (screenshot 12 Oct): Execution Failed detections

lines.say: It saw a spike in failed executions, over a hundred times normal, and raised an incident on its own.
lines.cap: It saw a spike in failed executions — over 100× normal — and raised an incident on its own.

lines.say: Its investigation found the root cause: a corrupt invoice, passed to Gemini anyway.
lines.cap: Its investigation found the root cause: a corrupt invoice, passed to Gemini anyway.

lines.say: Traces caught more. Before one fix, the agent dropped three of its five competitors. After it, it kept all five, in five runs out of five.
lines.cap: Traces caught more. Before one fix, the agent dropped 3 of its 5 competitors. After it, it kept all 5 — in 5 runs out of 5.

lines.say: And on twenty-four real invoices, the reader copied the net amount, not the total. After the fix, zero silent wrong totals.
lines.cap: And on 24 real invoices, the reader copied the net amount, not the total. After the fix: zero silent wrong totals.
